The activity "Reconcile incoming supplier billing against materials received this quarter" requires:
- Accounts payable/billing reconciliation capabilities
- Supplier invoice matching functionality
- Receipt/procurement matching logic
- Financial reconciliation workflows

None of the candidates directly provide billing reconciliation, invoice matching, or AP automation. While some candidates address materials, procurement, and inventory topics (which are topically related to supplier billing), they lack the specific capability to reconcile supplier invoices against received goods—a core accounts payable function. The candidates focus on material/engineering coordination, product lifecycle management, and inventory synchronization, but not on billing reconciliation workflows.
